name: Node from .nvmrc
description: Installs the Node version your workspace pins in .nvmrc at container-create time, and selects it in every interactive shell (including on `cd`). Drives an nvm that is already in the image — it does not install Node or nvm itself; pair it with ghcr.io/devcontainers/features/node or anything else that provides nvm.

nvmDir.description: Directory holding nvm.sh. The default is where ghcr.io/devcontainers/features/node puts it.

installOnCreate.description: Run `nvm install` for the workspace's .nvmrc at create time.

autoUseOnCd.description: Append an ~/.bashrc block that runs `nvm use` on shell start and on `cd` into a directory with a .nvmrc.

fixNodeModulesOwnership.description: Before installing, chown an existing ./node_modules to the create-time user. Repairs a named volume mounted there, which first mounts root-owned.
